slides.label: How to run a college club
slides.title: Your whole club in *one Space.*
slides.lede: Space, team and roles, set up in 10 minutes.

slides.title: Set up your Space
slides.text: Name, link and one line about your club. Every event and member lives here.

slides.title: Add your core team
slides.text: Search for their Unifesto account and add them. One or two Space Admins, everyone else a member.

slides.title: Decide who can do what
slides.text: Curator runs the event. Co-Curator helps. Crew scans at the gate. *Money stays with the Curator.*

slides.title: Start an event with a name
slides.text: It stays a draft. The checklist shows what's left before you publish.

slides.title: Give each event a team
slides.text: Pick people from your Space and set their role for that event only.

slides.title: Set up your Space *tonight.*
slides.lede: Free for RSVP events. When you graduate, hand the Space to next year's lead.
